cards.title: Google Gives Gemini Mac Control Abilities
cards.body: Google's latest Gemini update brings an AI agent to Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and handle multistep workflows. The agent automates routine desktop tasks for users.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Leaks Private Data
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse is mixing conversations and exposing sensitive user information in internal testing. Employees reported seeing unrelated childcare requests, career advice, product orders, and bank balances.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Debuts 33% Above Price
cards.body: Anthropic hit Nasdaq at $111 per share, significantly exceeding its $83 IPO price. The biotech-style company raised over $80 billion in new capital.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Commits to Paced AI Development
cards.body: During Nasdaq opening bell, Dario Amodei reaffirmed Anthropic's commitment to careful AI development. The company pledges to maintain this stance regardless of business or political pressure.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Tests AI's Circular Financing
cards.body: Anthropic faces massive compute costs while going public, with infrastructure partners like Amazon and Google potentially profiting regardless of market outcomes. The IPO tests whether circular financing benefits can sustain the company.

cards.title: Superhuman Expands Go Agent Availability
cards.body: Superhuman is making Go its central AI agent and deploying it across Docs and Mail. The expansion positions Go as the core productivity tool.

cards.title: Microsoft CEO Explains 60K Employee Buyouts
cards.body: Satya Nadella offered buyouts to 60,000 employees in October, urging voluntary departures instead of layoffs. AI requirements drove the restructuring, though not in the way many expected.

cards.title: Nadella Warns Critical Infrastructure Unpatchable
cards.body: Microsoft's CEO noted that much critical infrastructure is 'unpatchable' amid AI cyberattack fears. He acknowledged both opportunities and security challenges from AI advancement.

cards.title: Musk Compares Jensen Huang Ouster to Jordan
cards.body: Elon Musk criticized the removal of Nvidia's Jensen Huang, likening it to 'kicking Michael Jordan off your team.' He defended Huang's loyalty to the United States.

cards.title: Nadella Confident in Nvidia Leadership Transition
cards.body: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed confidence in Jensen Huang's successor Colette Kress as interim CEO. The vote of confidence signals stability in the critical partnership.

cards.title: Nadella: AI Agents Reshape Web Economics
cards.body: Microsoft's CEO predicts AI agents will disrupt advertising-driven business models fundamentally. Companies like Amazon may need to rethink customer acquisition strategies entirely.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Prices at $83 Per Share
cards.body: Anthropic set its IPO price at $83, above the projected range, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion fully diluted. The long-awaited public offering represents a major milestone.

cards.title: Nvidia Delays Routine SEC Quarterly Report
cards.body: Nvidia created Wall Street intrigue by announcing it won't file its 10-Q quarterly results document for weeks. The delay surprised analysts tracking the semiconductor giant.

cards.title: Palmer Luckey Warns AI Cyberattacks Accelerating
cards.body: Anduril co-founder Palmer Luckey warns AI-powered cyberattacks are outpacing defenses rapidly. Outdated technology leaves systems vulnerable to a new wave of AI-enabled threats.

cards.title: Luckey: China Benefits From Jensen's Ouster
cards.body: Palmer Luckey argues that removing Jensen Huang weakens America geopolitically. He calls for the ousted Nvidia CEO's reinstatement to maintain competitive advantage.

cards.title: Altman Unfazed by Garfield Movie Portrayal
cards.body: Sam Altman said Andrew Garfield portraying him in an upcoming film ranks low on his weirdness scale. 'It doesn't feel like it's in the top 10 weirdest things,' he noted.

cards.title: Snapchat Adds AI Assistants to AR Lens Creation
cards.body: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses using AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. Creators can describe their vision in plain language for automated implementation.

cards.title: Google Search AI Mode Gets Incognito Privacy
cards.body: Google introduced temporary threads for AI Mode conversations without storing search history. Users can chat with AI without influencing future recommendations.

cards.title: Banks Restrict Personal Finance AI Agent Liability
cards.body: Major financial institutions including Citi are limiting personal finance AI agents due to liability concerns. Banks are shifting responsibility to customers even if accounts get hacked.

cards.title: Everful Raises $48.5M for Factory Sourcing
cards.body: Everful secured $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct retail sourcing platform in China. The former Alibaba exec-led startup connects retailers with overseas manufacturers efficiently.

cards.title: AI Hype Index: AI Is Everywhere
cards.body: AI continues to proliferate across industries, from Google's AI Overviews to AI-powered humanoid robots. The technology is becoming increasingly ubiquitous despite mixed practical results and significant costs to companies.

cards.title: AI Startup Creates Artificial Nose
cards.body: Researchers in New Jersey are training an AI model to recognize odors by collecting data from human sniffers analyzing chemical compounds. The startup claims its AI olfactory system matches human smelling capabilities.

cards.title: Will Wright's AI Mines Your Memories
cards.body: Designer Will Wright is developing MyMems, an AI-powered simulation that uses machine learning to extract and process personal memories. The project aims to 'turn the simulation inward' for personalized content generation.

cards.title: Waymo Robotaxis Exit Freeway Operations
cards.body: Waymo has discontinued freeway driving for its autonomous vehicle fleet, citing safety and operational concerns. The AI-driven robotaxis now focus exclusively on local street navigation.
